'''Ice Burst''' is the second tier [[ice spell]] from the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook, available at level 70 [[Magic]]. It is capable of hitting up to 22 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Ice Burst can [[freeze]] targets, causing them to become unable to move for {{ticks|16}}, or {{ticks|17}} with the [[ancient sceptre]]. It is also able to target up to 9 targets in a 3x3 grid around its primary target, just like all other [[Burst spells|burst]] and [[barrage spells]].

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

Ice Burst is commonly used in [[Castle Wars]] and the [[Fight Pits]], due to its relative low cost and level requirement compared with [[Ice Barrage]], and the relatively large number of targets in small spaces, especially on crowded worlds.

It is also used as a cheaper alternative to [[Ice Barrage]] for certain [[Slayer task]]s such as [[dust devil]]s, or when used to train [[Magic]] (and [[Defence]]) quickly; See [[Pay-to-play Magic training#Level 70–94/99 – Bursting MM2 Monkeys|Magic training]] for more information.

Ice Burst, like all Ice spells, gains a 10% accuracy bonus against unfrozen targets while wielding the [[ice ancient sceptre]].
